attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Veterinary Medicine (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.alternatives: Credential from a state or an organization recognized by NAVTA (VTNE plus AVMA-accredited program); any CE follows that credentialing body's rules.
rules.notes: New Hampshire does not license or register veterinary technicians; no state CE applies. The Board licenses veterinarians (RSA 332-B); its rules define a veterinary technician as someone credentialed by a state government or a NAVTA-recognized organization and make technicians the professional responsibility of the supervising veterinarian (Vet 405.01). The CE rule (Vet 403.01, 30 hours) applies to licensees, i.e. veterinarians.
rules.legal_basis: RSA 332-B; N.H. Admin. R. Vet 102.01(an), Vet 405.01
rules.rule_quote: (2) Is credentialed as having the appropriate training and experience by a state government or an organization recognized by the National Association of Veterinary Technicians in America to issue the credential.
